name: zone_pressure_requests
description: Static pressure reset requests from one VAV zone. Output yPreReq is 3 when the damper has been open for open_time and the zone is served and the airflow is starved below three_fraction of its setpoint; else 2 when the damper has been open for open_time and the zone is served and the airflow is starved below two_fraction of its setpoint; else 1 while the damper is open; else 0. The damper is open once its position goes above damper_open, and stays open until its position is no longer above damper_open minus damper_band. The zone is served once its airflow setpoint goes above served_flow, and stays served until the setpoint is no longer above served_flow minus served_band. The airflow is starved below a fraction of its setpoint once (fraction times setpoint minus airflow) goes above 0, and stays starved until that difference is no longer above minus flow_band. Timing at the edges: all thresholds are strict (a damper at exactly 0.95 is not open; a damper that is open closes at exactly 0.85). The open time restarts every time the damper opens, and a damper already open at the first frame still has to stay open for the full open_time before the 2 or 3 requests can appear (it sends 1 meanwhile).

params.name: damper_open
params.meaning: Position above which the damper counts as open

params.name: open_time
params.meaning: How long the damper must stay open before airflow requests count

params.name: served_flow
params.meaning: Airflow setpoint above which the zone counts as served

params.name: three_fraction
params.meaning: Fraction of setpoint below which a starved zone sends 3 requests

params.name: two_fraction
params.meaning: Fraction of setpoint below which a starved zone sends 2 requests

params.name: flow_band
params.meaning: Release band on the starved-airflow conditions
